name: labs/opentrons__opentrons-modules
title: Opentrons Temp Deck Gen 3
intro: Opentrons Temp Deck Gen 3, adapted from opentrons/opentrons-modules. It reads `plate_temperature_1`, `plate_temperature_2`, `heatsink_temperature`, `peltier_current` and 2 more; sets `fan_power`; runs `set_target_temperature` and `deactivate`. `set_target_temperature`: set the target temperature of a thermal zone and optionally wait for the zone to reach the setpoint within a declared tolerance. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
